news.title: Lionel Messi announces retirement from international football
news.lede: News On AIR | September 1, 2026 6:13 AM. Lionel Messi announced his retirement from international football, bringing an end to a 20-year Argentina career that included a World Cup triumph, two Copa América titles and a record 207 appearances for his country. Messi said the decision had been on his mind since the World Cup final defeat to Spain, before the death of his father further convinced him it was time to step away. The 39-year-old revealed the decision in a statement posted on his official Instagram account, confirming that he would no longer wear the Argentina jersey after one of the most celebrated international careers in football history.

news.title: World Cup wishlists, early movers, big clearouts: 2026 summer transfer window trends
news.lede: At the end of a busy transfer window which spanned the World Cup, here are some of the subplots of the summer. The World Cup is always a good shop window. Yan Diomande was already a rising star at RB Leipzig but shining for Côte d’Ivoire in the US helped push up his price tag before a £115.7m move to Real Madrid. There were other breakout stars: Switzerland’s Johan Manzambi, whose signature Aston Villa pipped Newcastle to; Bosnia and Herzegovina’s Kerim Alajbegovic, who went to Juventus; and Ghana’s Caleb Yirenkyi, who is now in the Premier League with Coventry.

news.title: AFA orders tribute to Messi, with applause in the 10th minute of matches
news.lede: A round of applause for the captain who has said goodbye: footballers and fans across Argentina will pause matches at all levels of the game in the 10th minute this weekend to pay tribute to Lionel Messi, who announced his retirement from the national team on Monday. The measure was arranged by the Argentine Football Association (AFA) as a tribute to the legendary number 10, who at 39 years of age has brought an end to his glorious international career with the Albiceleste. The tribute will take place during the next match day across all men's and women's matches at all categories and all groups, AFA announced in a statement. It applies to 11-a-side football, futsal and beach football.
